content: To help reduce the risk of developing dementia, certain lifestyle modifications are recommended. These include engaging in weight-bearing exercises, quitting smoking, limiting alcohol consumption, and maintaining a well-balanced diet that provides sufficient calcium and vitamin D. If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store your medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed. The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about the product.
